item2_hull_polish.definition: at the certified cycle, every coupling entry is constrained ENTRYWISE to the closed interval [min, max] of the agents' achieved values: V and PF over the two agents (TSO copy, DSO copy), ESS over the three agents (TSO, DSO, ESSO copies); a degenerate interval (equal values) is a fixed value; each block is feasible by construction because its own achieved point lies in the hull
item2_hull_polish.exact_fix_finding: the exact-fix outcome (17/48 infeasible at the certified point) is recorded as a methodological finding (one manuscript sentence)
item2_hull_polish.flag: any block with Delta_i > 1e-6 * certified cost (= 650.97) is flagged as a solver artefact, not distortion
item2_hull_polish.gap: Delta = sum_i [f_i(polished) - f_i(certified)] over the 48 blocks on the weighted base objective, gross_operational_cost convention; expected <= 0 by construction
item2_hull_polish.interpretation: block-stationarity at the certified tolerance (a bound on augmented-Lagrangian distortion), NOT optimality evidence for the nonconvex problem; polished sides may differ by up to the certified residual
item2_hull_polish.objective: unscaled base objective as in P5.7 (ADMM objective and the p58 rescaled objective deactivated)

method.activation: active from cycle 1; memory cleared at EVERY rho change on any channel (balancing step, ESS exemption lift, freeze)

method.iterate: stacked (z, u) over all channels, scaled as in the Boyd residual-test normalization (V in pu, PF in pu, ESS divided by S_ref); g = F(w) - w
method.safeguard: no extra solves: an AA step is taken only while the combined scaled residual at the current cycle is below the residual recorded before the last accepted AA step; otherwise the plain iterate is used and the memory cleared (the Fu-Zhang-Boyd envelope form is acceptable; the implemented choice is recorded)
